# Agentic First

> Umbrella site and open-source materials for the Agentic First operating stance: make organisations legible to agents while keeping human judgement, approval, and accountability explicit.

Canonical site:

- https://agentic-first.co/

Alternate domain:

- https://agent-first.co/ should redirect to https://agentic-first.co/

## Main Routes

- `/` - Agentic First overview and framing
- `/directory/` - Agentic First Directory product, profile standard, schemas, validator, and publishing guidance
- `/directory/mcp` - Directory MCP endpoint
- `/directory/schemas/` - canonical profile schemas
- `/directory/feedback` - directory feedback endpoint or form

## Repository Layout

- `README.md` - umbrella concept and route model
- `directory/README.md` - directory overview
- `directory/SPEC.md` - full profile standard
- `directory/schemas/` - versioned JSON Schemas
- `directory/examples/` - example public and protected profiles
- `directory/docs/` - publishing, reader, security, feedback, and host recipes
- `directory/skills/` - drop-in skills for agentic-first publishing and reading
- `directory/python/agentic_first_schema/` - Python validator and CLI

## Concept

Agentic First means designing public information and private access paths so agents can read, verify, and act safely.

Use this distinction:

- Humans set goals, values, approvals, risk appetite, and judgement calls.
- Agents read structured information, perform bounded work, and escalate where approval is required.
- Organisations publish source-owned facts instead of relying only on third-party profiles or scraped pages.

## Directory Compatibility

The old public MCP endpoint was:

- https://directory.agentic-first.co/mcp

The target endpoint is:

- https://agentic-first.co/directory/mcp

Keep the legacy endpoint available during migration. Proxying is safer than redirecting for MCP clients until client compatibility is confirmed.
